note: Shared AI-AGENT RUNTIME catalog (Teleon-owned). An agent runtime RECEIVES a bounded agent request and is PROVISIONED onto a Teleon execution backend (local emulator / K8s job / sandbox worker / cloud function) via src.teleon.runtime.execution_backend_selector.select_backend -> ExecutionProviderPort. Candidate runtimes (ClawLess/OpenClaw, Hermes) are NEVER imported/executed here -- catalog entries only, naming an env:// runtime/credential ref; the offline correctness invariant is local_emulator@v1. Agent output is NEVER truth (serves_truth=false): agents DISCOVER/ACT and PROPOSE; Baltor stores/verifies/reconciles/consumes. Baltor is a TENANT that submits requests; it does not own this layer. This layer RIDES the existing ExecutionProviderPort + FleetLedger -- it is NOT a second worker framework. No raw keys -- runtime_ref (env://) only.

positioning.law: agents PROPOSE, Baltor DISPOSES; runtime provisioning is Teleon; an open-ended agent never auto-runs on a generic cloud function (hard guard) -- it provisions onto a K8s job / sandbox worker unless a policy override asserts a proof; never a second worker framework (rides FleetLedger + ExecutionProviderPort).

runtimes.note: offline correctness invariant -- runs a bounded deterministic agent task; no network; no real container; output is a candidate proposal, never truth.

browser/WASM WebContainer agent lab -- candidate only; never imported/executed; dev-only keys behind owner gate; provision onto sandbox_worker / k8s_job, NOT a generic cloud function by default. It is an agent runtime/sandbox, NOT a free LLM endpoint (that distinction lives in free_endpoint_intel).

open-ended agent runtime -- candidate only; never imported/executed; provision onto k8s_job / sandbox_worker behind owner gate; output is a candidate proposal that returns to Baltor's governance rail.
